name: Injury-rotation over (shape only)
rule: Frozen before the first bet. Any change to signal, threshold, universe or settlement is a NEW strategy with a NEW id and a new hash; the old record is never edited, so a reader can always tell whether the rule moved.
settlement_rule: requires a player prop line to settle; NO prop line exists, so this strategy is NOT MEASURABLE and is registered for completeness only.
signal: club has a top-8 minute earner OUT, so the replacement share is > 12%
thesis: Minutes redistribution is the mechanism by which an absence changes a total. The gate that stops it is a missing price, not a missing model.
threshold: replacement share ≥ 0.12 on the club's own box score
universe: clubs with a transcribed box score only (1 club-game in this capture)
